definition.title: What Is an AI UGC Video Ad Generator?
paras: Start with one product photo and one scene idea, then get a short creator-style clip that shows one clear product action.
The presenter and setting are AI-generated. Download the clip and add final captions, prices or licensed music in your editor.

steps.d: Upload one clear product photo with the full item visible. Keep the important details easy to inspect.
Describe where the ad happens and what the person does. Keep one focused action so shoppers follow the hook.
Download the clean clip when the render is ready. Add captions, prices or licensed music in your editor for each channel.

faq.q: What does an AI UGC video ad show?
faq.a: It shows your product in one clear scene with a spoken line or visible action. The presenter and setting are AI-generated.

faq.q: Can I make an ad without hiring a creator or studio?
faq.a: Yes. Start with one product photo and a focused idea, then make the scene without casting, booking or a studio day.

faq.q: Where can I post the finished ad?
faq.a: Post a 9:16 clip to TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts, then add the copy and offer details for that channel.

faq.q: What product photo gives the clearest result?
faq.a: Use a clear, well-lit photo with the full product visible and its important details easy to inspect.

faq.q: Can I add captions, prices or music after download?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact text and licensed music after download in TikTok, CapCut or your ad editor.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. Pick the length that gives one action a clear beginning and end.

faq.q: How many credits does a video ad cost?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. Failed jobs return credits automatically.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is an AI-generated brand performer, not a customer endorsement. Use a factual script and disclose AI content when a platform requires it.
